days.title: HCMC day 1 — everyone lands
days.tip: The host confirmed early bag drop-off: drop bags at the Airbnb on the way to breakfast, check in properly from 3pm. Late arrivals let themselves in with the door codes.

events.label: Check out, drop bags at the Airbnb
events.note: Host confirmed early drop-off. Grab from the hotel (25–35 min), then 10–15 min on to Hòa Mã.

events.label: Coffee + bánh mì: Hòa Mã
events.note: 53 Cao Thắng, D3. Keep it light: a bánh mì and an iced milk coffee. Closes 11am and can sell out — take one to go if needed. 4-min Grab to Resel.

events.label: Jonathan: Nhựt Tailor
events.note: While Joyce is at Resel. 232 Lê Thánh Tôn, by Bến Thành Market — ~10-min Grab from Hòa Mã. Then ~10–15-min Grab to Bánh Xèo 46A to meet Joyce at 12:15.

events.label: Lunch: Bánh Xèo 46A
events.note: 46 Đinh Công Tráng, Tân Định. Crispy bánh xèo, Bib Gourmand. Lunch ends 1:50pm; expect a queue.

events.label: Coffee: Cộng Cà Phê
events.note: 274 Hai Bà Trưng, opposite the Pink Church. Church photo from the sidewalk.

events.label: Joyce + Jonathan: Premium Momo Nails & Spa
events.note: End time is flexible; meet Andrew at the Café Apartments when done. Leave Huelley Rose by ~2:45 to get there for 3. Andrew checks in with the door code and rests.

events.label: Café Apartments
events.note: 42 Nguyễn Huệ, a 14-min walk from the Airbnb. Pick a café from the lobby board (lift 3,000 VND); a balcony or rooftop floor catches the 5:27pm sunset.

events.label: Walk Nguyễn Huệ to the river
events.note: Down to Tôn Đức Thắng and back past the Opera House. Busy on weekend nights — keep phones close.

events.label: Dinner: Bếp Nhà Lục Tỉnh
events.note: 37 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa. Mekong Delta home cooking: bánh khọt + sweet-sour hotpot. Booked 7pm — confirm it is for 3 on Sat (028 3915 3999, Zalo @bepnhaluctinh).

events.label: Bar 1: Stir
events.note: 1st floor, alley 136 Lê Thánh Tôn. Asia's 50 Best #84. Walk-ins OK, but it fills on Saturdays: book if you can (+84 788 333 136).

events.label: Bar 2: Summer Experiment
events.note: 77–79 Lý Tự Trọng. Open until 2am, 12 min walk to the Airbnb. Takes walk-ins and bookings; book if you can on a Saturday.

events.label: Late phở with all five
events.note: Phở Việt Nam, 14 Phạm Hồng Thái — 5 min from the Airbnb, open until 3am.

days.title: HCMC day 2 — Joyce's shoot
days.tip: Joyce's RINTRAN shoot is 12–3pm in District 7 (89A Lý Phục Man, about 20–25 min by Grab). Everyone does the morning together, the other four lunch and see the War Remnants Museum, and all five regroup at the Airbnb by 3:30. Bring cash: Ốc Đào and the museum take cash only.

events.label: Breakfast: Hủ tiếu cá Nam Lợi
events.note: 43 Tôn Thất Đạm, 10 min walk. Light fish noodle soup; weekend hours 6am–noon. Backup: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho Thanh Xuân, 62 Tôn Thất Thiệp (6am–1:30pm).

events.label: Central Post Office + Notre-Dame
events.note: Grab ~8 min. Post Office is free and likely open Sunday; the cathedral is outside only (restoration). Souvenir sellers and a donation-photo bear: just walk past.

events.label: Book Street
events.note: Đường sách Nguyễn Văn Bình, next to the Post Office. Lively on Sundays.

events.label: Joyce: back to the Airbnb to get ready
events.note: Grab ~10 min. Leave for District 7 by 11:30 (about 20–25 min). Take water and a snack.

events.label: The four: coffee at XLIII
events.note: 178a Pasteur, AC. Pricey specialty coffee (tasting tiers 125–500k VND). 8 min walk to lunch.

events.label: The four: lunch at Mặn Mòi
events.note: 34 Võ Văn Tần, D3, levels 2–3. Bib Gourmand home-style Vietnamese. Book for 4 on TableCheck or +84 899 189 218.

events.label: The four: War Remnants Museum
events.note: 28 Võ Văn Tần, next door. 40k VND cash, open 7:30am–6pm. Graphic galleries. If Joyce wants to see it too, do Independence Palace now and the museum together on Nov 23 morning.

events.label: Regroup at the Airbnb, rest
events.note: Joyce is back ~3:25. AC, snacks, naps for Peter and Olivia.

events.label: Sunset: Social Club Rooftop
events.note: Hôtel des Arts, 24th floor, 76-78 Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai. Sunset 5:27pm. Book a table for 5 (+84 28 3989 8888). Smart casual.

events.label: Dinner: Ốc Đào
events.note: 212B/D48 Nguyễn Trãi. Michelin-listed snails and shellfish. Cash only. Arrive by 6:30, ask for the AC 2nd floor. Order ốc hương, garlic-butter shellfish, grilled oysters, bread.

events.label: Bar 1: The Enigma Mansion
events.note: 5H Tôn Đức Thắng. Asia's 50 Best #55. Grab ~10 min. Book for 5; splurge-ish.

events.label: Bar 2: CỘI Jazz
events.note: 77-79 Lý Tự Trọng (Summer Experiment's building). Live jazz on weekends, fills fast on Sundays: book (+84 833 167 332). 12 min walk home, or Bùi Viện if anyone's still going.

_events: days[].events: suggested or derived times shown on the Hours page. time is HH:MM Vietnam time; values past 24:00 mean after midnight. fuzzy: true draws it as an estimate.
_stops: days[].stops: places for the Map page, in the order we visit them. Stops with lat/lng are pinned and joined by the path; off: true pins it without joining the path (side trips, one person's errand); maybe: true marks it as undecided; a stop without lat/lng is listed but not pinned; {"leg": "..."} splits the day (e.g. a flight) so each part gets its own map view. Order is our best guess where Notion gives no times.
